mapper.sql: id, purpose, binding_digest, verification_data, created_at, expires_at, consumed_at, create_key, verify_key, verify_fingerprint, consumed_key, consumed_fingerprint, state
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE binding_digest = #{binding} AND create_key = #{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE binding_digest = #{binding} AND created_at > clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
mapper.update: UPDATE app.captcha_challenge SET verify_key = #{key}, verify_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, state = #{state}, verification_data = #{material}, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE app.captcha_challenge SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = clock_timestamp(), consumed_key = #{key}, consumed_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'VERIFIED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM app.captcha_challenge WHERE expires_at < clock_timestamp() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' LIMIT 100)
